svg.text: Under the Hood: Chaos Engineering & Fault-Tolerance Pipelines
How METIX-Switch preserves zero double-debits, strict 25s SPIM SLA finality, Notice No. 1/GBM/2026 caps, and balanced double-entry books under failure
FAULT 1 · 5× Concurrent Duplicate Retry Storm (Mobile Network Flakiness)
Commits SwitchTx + Leg 1 Hold → binds idemp:tx:{k}
Poll GET idemp:tx:{k} (50ms backoff) → load tx
• All 5 concurrent + 1 sequential retry return HTTP 200 with the exact same transaction.id and STAN.
• Originator debited exactly once; Beneficiary credited exactly once; Daily Redis limit incremented once.
• Secondary guard on STAN + RRN prevents ISO-level replay even if caller rotates the HTTP idempotency header.
FAULT 2 · Dropped 0210 ACK / Timeout (>25s SPIM SLA) + Late-0210 Race
Late-0210 Race Protection & Exact Ledger Invariant (test_3_beneficiary_timeout_over_25s_sla)
• If a delayed 0210 arrives after sweeper claimed the row, SwitchEngine locks via SELECT ... FOR UPDATE,
sees status != ROUTED, audits the late frame, and refuses to double-credit Beneficiary.
• Result: Sender restored to exact 100% balance, Beneficiary untouched, METIX-SUSPENSE = 0.00 MT.
FAULT 3 · Notice No. 1/GBM/2026 Cap (DE 39=61) & Inoperative PSP (DE 39=91)
Individual Daily Cap Exceeded (> 200,000.00 MT) → DE 39 = 61
FAULT 4 · High-Concurrency Contention, Deadlocks & Container Restarts
2. Sort debit/credit accounts by UUID (0 deadlocks)
Guarantees atomic versioned writes + balanced postings
PG rolls back; except handler deletes Redis lock
& releases daily limit → safe client retry
PG WAL preserves ROUTED + Suspense hold.
Replays AOF everysec + RDB from metix_redisdata;
idempotency, caps, STAN & chaos persist intact
